record.provider: Lanzou Premium (蓝奏云优享版, ilanzou)

free_tier.stated: A free account has a free tier: the vendor page publishes no quota figure, and a third-party page reports 10 GB, or 2 TB for one year after registration and account authentication, against 10 TB for a member. Per-file cap is above the legacy 100 MB

per_object_cap.stated: Above the legacy 100 MB and not published as one number; large-file resolution needs an account

egress.terms: Ordinary users upload and download with no speed limit ('普通用户上传下载永不限速'); files under 100 MB download from a share link without a login, larger files need a login unless the downloader is…

record.tooling: Reverse-engineered clients mount it: the OpenList ilanzou driver takes an account and password and has no share mode, and the netdisk-fast-download iz parser needs authentication only for large files
record.chaining: Nothing to multiply, because the capacity is paid. Its role in the topic is as the resolver's iz driver, which is what makes legacy Lanzou links reachable when the direct CDN refuses

limits.value: above 100 MB and unpublished; large-file resolution needs an account

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the vendor home page shows only a login control and no registration form. A third-party page says registration plus 'account authentication' (账号认证) unlocks the 2 TB year, and what that authentication asks for is not stated. Behind a sign-up

record.reliability_note: The same rotating-CDN problem as legacy Lanzou, plus one observed failure that matters: the resolver issued a direct URL anonymously and the connection then could not be made. A resolved link is not a delivered file

evidence.proved: 302 to https://small5.bakstotre.com/...491744860608972.rar with a filename, so a direct URL was issued anonymously; the connection then failed after 23 seconds
'在线预览, 下载免登录, 不限速, 无损存储'
the driver needs 账户、密码 only
the iz parser needs authentication for large files

evidence.proved: the OpenList ilanzou driver is configured with an ilanzou account and password

record.binding_note: The capacity is paid and no free figure is published, so the free tier cannot be shown to reach anything. The per-file cap is the number a buyer would need and the page does not publish it.
record.notes: The one probe is a real finding: a share resolved anonymously and the CDN then refused the TCP connection, which is why the record says a resolved link is not a delivered file.
